positions.name: SprintDeliveryEvidenceQuantified
positions.frame: what counts as evidence that a sprint delivered on the decision-capture mechanism?
positions.why: All three expressions are flat, unhedged assertive claims (conviction: claim, not decision) delivered in the same matter-of-fact/technical register and calm-positive affect, each anchoring the sprint's success to a concrete, checkable fact: a shipped artifact (src-1), a quantified metric (src-2), and a named causal driver (src-3). Read together they form a single evidentiary triad — deliverable, measurement, and attribution — rather than three independent claims; the value-dimension reads (self-enhancement/competence) and the shared past/realis/concrete temporal frame reinforce that they are being offered as one settled record of execution, not as a decision or ratified rule.
